# Field boundaries for North Rhine-Westphalia (NRW), Germany

Germany, North Rhine-Westphalia field boundaries (2026) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Land Nordrhein-Westfalen / Open.NRW. License: DL-DE-BY-2.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_nrw/latest/de_nrw.parquet
- All editions: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_nrw/year=*/*.parquet (hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:25832; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: id, hcat:name, crop:code, collection, geometry, flik, crop:name, determination:datetime, hcat:name_en, metrics:area, hcat:code, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_nrw/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_nrw/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_nrw/collection.json
